# True when this location's raw material feeds the building type in root.
# Scope: location, root: building_type
bag_rgo_location_feeds_root = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			raw_material = goods:alum
			root = { bag_rgo_consumes_alum = yes }
		}

			raw_material = goods:amber
